richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Giridih

c: Giridih is a district town in Jharkhand, known for the Parasnath hills and the coal fields around it. Its schools, colleges, colonies and municipal parks are the usual buyers when we receive an outdoor gym enquiry from here. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to all of these, made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 1,480 km away, and sent by road.

School grounds in smaller towns often double as the local sports field, and anything installed there gets heavy use after school hours as well. We suggest a few solid, simple machines placed at one side of the ground, away from the main play area. Our installation team or a dealer in eastern India installs them on grouted bases. Send us a photo of the ground and its size, and we will send a layout drawing showing each station and its clear zone.

items.q: What machines last longest on a public school ground?
items.a: Machines with few moving parts, such as parallel bars, pull up stations and simple twisters. They are easy to understand and need less upkeep than complex frames.

items.q: Can the community use the school's outdoor gym after school hours?
items.a: That is for the school to decide. If it does, place the gym at the edge of the ground near an entrance so it can be used without crossing the main sports area.

items.q: How far is Giridih from your factory?
items.a: About 1,480 km by road from Vasai. We manufacture the machines there, send them by road and install them with our team or a dealer in eastern India.
